mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, compounded by dronedarone's Class III antiarrhythmic effects and QT-prolonging potential.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) closely during concurrent use; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs; consider alternative antivirals if possible, and correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly.
